tei:div.tei:p: ༄༅/ /skyer sgang lugs kyi yi ge drug pa'i nyer mkho cung zad gcig bzhugs so// skyer sgang pa'i mdzad pa'i thugs rje chen po'i chos skor las/ nyer mkho bsdus pa las gzungs chu byed par 'dod na snod gas chag med par rin po che la sogs pa'i snod du chu srog chags can la sogs pa ma yin pa/ gtsang ma blugs la mdun du bzhag rang yi ge drug par bsgom/ mdun du spyan ras gzigs zhal bcu gcig pa rang gi thugs kha'i hrī'i 'od zer gyis spyan drangs la jo bo yi ge drug pa'i thugs kha'i hrīḥlas 'od zer rnam pa lnga 'phros pas sna la me tog la sogs pa jo bo la phul bar bsam la/ ngag tu sngags 'di brjod par bya'o/ /oṃ badz+ra puṣ+pe āḥhūm̐ swā hā/ oṃ badz+ra dhu pe āḥhūm̐ swā hā/ oṃ badz+ra gan+de āḥhūm̐ swā hā/ oṃ badz+ra ne bi t+ye āḥhūm̐ swā hā/ oṃ badz+ra shap+ta āḥhūm̐ swā hā/ zhes brjod la mchod pa 'bul/ de nas rang gi byed na rang gi ming gzhug gzhan gyi byed na che ge mo'i nad dang gdon dang gnod pa dang bar du gcod pa thams cad zhi bar mdzad du gsol/ zhes gsol ba lan gsum su btab pas rje btsun spyan ras gzigs kyi g.yon gyi gsum pa na ril ba spyi blugs yod pa/ de yo byas nas de'i nang nas bdud rtsi dkar dmar re re chu'i nang du blug par bsam zhing yi ge drug pa sum brgya'am brgya rtsa brgyad bzlas/ de nas jo bo la mchod pa rnams snga ma bzhin phul la gshegs su gsol/ de nas khrus byed khar rang bsrung pa la yi ge drug pa lan bdun bzlas la/ sngar gyi spyan ras gzigs spyan drangs la sngar gyi spyi blugs nas bdud rtsi byung bas sdig sgrib dang nad dang gdon la sogs pa thams cad nag nyil nyil song bar bsam/ gzhan la ldugs na'ang de bzhin du byas la mgo nas mar blugs/ 'phar ba la sogs pa 'ong na rang gi snying khar/ hūm̐ ljang khu las rdo rje rgya gram ljang khu bskyed la/

mi de'i mgo thog na mar song bar bsam la/ de'i steng du blug go /dge ba bsngo'o/ /srung skud byed na/ shi ba'i bal ma yin pa la/ bsgrim dus su 'jur bu med pa dang / ma chad pa dang / ma shor ba bya/ mdud pa gsum la/ oṃ aḥhūm̐ gsum bsam mo/ /bsrung skud la yi ge drug pa 'khril bar bsam/ /de nas srung skud snyim par bcug la/ sngags brgya rtsa brgyad brjod pas rdo rje'i thag par gyur par bsam la/ rang gis byed na mdud pa byed dus su sngags bdun bzlas so/ /snying rje'i bsrung ba la gnad blo sbyong dang 'dra bar 'dug stong nyid bsrung ba la/ rang gi lus grub phung po'i mdud/ de las dbugs 'gro 'chi bdag nyon mongs gnas pa nyon mongs/ yul rten dga' bskyed lha'i bu'i bdud de rnams rang sems rnam pa tsam/ lus grub na yang a nas grub/ 'jig pa na yang a nas 'jig rang gi lte bar a dkar bsam/ de las 'od byung lus gang nas/ phyir 'phros snod bcud kun la phog sdig sgrib sbyangs nas 'od du yal/ stong nyid ngang du ci gnas bzhag ldang na a nas snod bcud kun/ lha'i dkyil 'khor nyid du'o/ /gnas bsrung ba ni/ mal gyi zur bzhir hrīḥbazhi bsam/ /'og tu hrīḥmago mthur bstan gcig /steng du'ang 'og gi de 'dra gcig /hrīḥbazhi 'od dmar khrug gis 'dres/ /'og hrī me ni zur gsum 'bar/ /steng du'ang zur gsum 'bar bar bsam/ /steng gis lha'i bu'i bdud bsrung / /phyogs bzhis mes ni rgyal chen bzhi'i/ /'khor du gnas pa'i gnod sbyin bsrung / /'og gi des ni gnod sbyin bsrung / /gzhi la sngo dus mi bsdu bar/ /srod la gsal gdab 'gro na bsdu/ /drag po'i bsrung ba rta mgrin no/ /sa gnyan sar sdod na thugs kha'i hrīḥ'i 'od kyis dmyal ba'i bar gyi nyes skyon sbyangs par bsam nas bzlas pa bya'o/ /bsdus pa'o/ /gtor ma brgya rtsa dang brul gtor 'dra/ sdig sbyong / sdig gang yid la bcags pa de'i nang du sdig thams cad bsdus te lce thog tu nag bun nge bsam/

de nas yi ge drug pa bzlas pas phu chu drag pos bye ma la rgyab pa bzhin ha ra ra zad par bsam/ 'jog khar sangs kyi dag par bsam/ stong pas rgyas btab/ dge ba bsngo/ stobs bzhi sbyor tshul gzhung na gsal/ sats+tsha la/ 'jim stong hrīḥmathar yig drug bsam/ /de zhu shol gyi phung por mos/ /ma ṇi brjod nas las kun bya/ /rab gnas rgyas bsdus skabs dang sbyar/ /chu sbyin gzhan 'dra mdor bsdus ni/ /snying rjes ma ṇi brjod cing chu gtor yang ngo / /chu mig 'bab chu sogs bdud rtsi'i byin brlab pas chog sbyin sreg zhi rgyas dbang drag dbyibs ni spyi dang mthun par gsungs/ zangs gzhong nang du mar me gzhag lhar bskyed rdzas ni 'bru sna tshogs/ shing bal me tog gzugs byas pas/ 'bul sngags yi ge drug pa la zhi ba la shin taṃ ku ru ye swā hā/ zhes sbyar/ de bzhin du/ rgyas pa la/ puṣ+ṭiṃ ku ru oṃ/ dbang la/ wa shang ku ru hoḥ drag po la ma ra ya phaṭa/ sdig sbyong sbyin sreg chen mo ni/ me tog mang btus grib skam bya/ las sbyor sa dkar tsan dan dkar po'i chus chag chag btab/ de'i dkyil du dang po zlum po zabs su khru gang kha skor khru phyed de grus la de'i kha ras kyis bcad/ de'i steng du mañdzi bzhag de'i khar zangs la sogs pa'i snod kyi steng du yi ge drug pa'i sku rab gnas can bzhugs/ mdun du mchod pa bsham/ gsol ba gdab pa ni/ jo bo thugs rje chen pos sems can thams cad kyis don du bdag gi sdig pa thams cad sbyang du gsol/ sdig lci ba yod na de'i ming 'don/ lan gsum/ lag pa g.yas pas me tog blangs nas jo bo'i thugs khar dbul/ g.yon pas phreng bas bgrang / bsnyen pa'i grangs kyi bcu cha phul/ dge rtsa bsngo/ rten phyir gshegs/ dang po zhabs su spra ba dkar po blug de nas me tog rnams blug de'i khar shing shug pa zlum por brtsig dbul ba'i rdzas ni shug pa legs par bshags khri tsho gcig la snum byugs pa g.yas su bzhag

dang po ni phyogs bzhir mchod pa tshar re re bsham nang du hrīḥlas yi ge drug pa bskyed/ sangs rgyas byang sems kyi mdun gyi nam mkha' gang bar bsam/ de rnams la dmigs la mdun gyi mchod pa phul/ yan lag bdun pa bya/ phyogs bcu na sogs nas dgongs su gsol bdag ming 'di zhes bgyi ba'i sdig pa thams cad myur du zad par mdzad du gsol/ tshogs thams cad myur du rdzogs par mdzad du gsol/ gsum g.yon gyi mchod pa tshar gcig yi ge drug pa la dbul/ gsol ba sngar ltar ro/ /de nas me spar shug pa 'gal re re/ jo bo'i zhal du phul bas bde stong gi rang bzhin du ldem song / bdag gi sdig pa thams cad sangs kyis song bar bsam/ rdzas re re'i gsham du shan+tiṃ ku ru btags/ rdzas zad nas rgyab kyi mchod pa phul/ gsol ba lan gsum btab/ tshogs yod na bza'/ yang g.yas kyi mchod pa phul/ oṃ ma ṇi pad+me bdag gi sdig pa thams cad shan+tiṃ ku ru ye swā hā/ zhes khri tsho gcig bzlas so/ /de nas bsreg spos lag tu thogs la jo bo la gsol ba gdab pa ni/ jo bo thugs rje chen po sems can thams cad kyi don du bdag gis dngos grub myur du thob par mdzad du gsol/ gsum/ dge rtsa bsngo/ thal ba rlung la bskur/ brul gtor btang / bsnyen pa byed na dge 'dun gyi tshogs bsog dang / dkon mchog la mchod/ me tog dkar po spungs pa'i khar jo bo'i sku rab gnas can bzhag la me tog snyim pa gsum phul la gsol ba gdab pa ni/ bdag gis sems can thams cad kyi don du mchog gi dngos grub myur du thob par byin gyis brlab tu gsol/ bar chad thams cad zhi bar byin gyis brlab tu gsol/ gsum/ grangs bsnyen/ 'bum tsho sum cu rtsa gnyis/ 'bring 'bum bdun/ tha ma gsum/ yang jo bo nas brgyud pa'i yig rnying gzhan las dus bsnyen zla ba gsum/ grangs bsnyen 'bum tsho bco brgyad ces gsung / yang yi ge la lar 'bum phrag drug tu'ang bshad do/

/bsnyen pa ma song bar las sbyor mi rung / wa ru ṇa'i gtor ma gzhung du'o/ /gtsang sbra gtso che/ sgrub thabs la rgyas pa gtso 'khor gsum/ bsdu na gtso bo gcig pu/ bsnyen pa la bskyed rim gtso che/ rigs gtad gzhung na'o/ /rdzogs rim ni lha bsdu ba sogs stong nyid bsgom pa de ka'o/ /snying rje gtso che/ nyal ldang khrus gsum zas gos sogs 'dra/ zhe sdang skyes na/ snying gi dkyil du yi ge ma gcig bsam/ de las 'od 'phros lus khengs pas nyon mongs zhi bar bsam/ 'od zer phyir 'phros sems can thams cad kyi nyon mongs zhi bar bsam la/ ma ṇi stong tsho re re bzla/ 'dod chags skyes na lte bar 'od dmar po bsam pa sogs dang / gti mug skyes na spyi bor ti nag po bsam pa sogs gong gis rigs 'gre/ dug gsum sbyangs 'di ma chag na nyon mongs kyis mi gos/ tshogs myur du rdzogs so// ༈ //nyal khar bcu gcig zhal gyi bris sku sogs yod na rab/ med kyang bsam la/ ngag tu/ jo bo thugs rje chen po la bdag lus 'bul gyis/ thams cad du rnam pa thams cad so sor bzhes su gsol/ gsum/ jo bo'i thugs khar bdag lus sib kyis thim par bsam/ mnyam par bzhag snying rje chen po las mi 'da' snyam pas ngag tu/ jo bo thugs rje chen pos bdag dam tshig chen po las mi 'da' ba'i dngos grub bstsal du gsol/ gsum/ dge ba bsngo/ tshogs 'khor byed na sha khrag dang chang 'dir mi rung dkar gsum sogs dgos/ zhib par yi ge rnying par btsal lo/ /zhes pa 'di bya bral ba sangs rgyas phun tshogs kyis e waṃ chos ldan du bris pa'o// //mad+ga laṃ// // PAGE \* MERGEFORMAT 4 sangs rgyas phun tshogs/ skyer sgang lugs kyi yi ge drug pa'i nyer mkho cung zad gcig PAGE \* MERGEFORMAT 1
